Local ID of the account on this server, for example 109302436954721982. Obtain it from Lookup Account, Search Accounts, Get Account or Search (use resolve for a remote user@domain).
actions.unmute_conversation.description: Resume notifications for a muted thread.
actions.unmute_conversation.props.status: Local ID of the status on this server, for example 109372843234737004. Obtain it from a timeline, Get Status or Search (use resolve for a status URL from another server).
actions.unpin_status.description: Remove a pinned status from your profile.
actions.unpin_status.props.status_id.des: Local ID of your own status. Obtain it from Create Status, Get Status or List Account Statuses.
actions.update_filter.description: Change the title, contexts, action or expiry of a content filter.
actions.update_filter.props.context.desc: Replaces where the filter applies. Leave empty to keep the current contexts.
actions.update_filter.props.expires_in.d: New expiry, in seconds from now. Leave empty to keep the current expiry.
actions.update_filter.props.filter_actio: What happens to matching posts. Leave empty to keep the current action.
actions.update_filter.props.filter_id.de: ID of the filter. Obtain it from List Filters or Create Filter.
actions.update_filter.props.title.descri: New name of the filter. Leave empty to keep the current title.
actions.update_list.description: Rename a list or change its settings.
actions.update_list.props.exclusive.desc: Whether posts from list members are removed from the home timeline. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
actions.update_list.props.list_id.descri: ID of one of your lists. Obtain it from List Lists or Create List.
actions.update_list.props.replies_policy: Which replies appear in the list timeline. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
actions.update_list.props.title.descript: New name of the list. Leave empty to keep the current title.
actions.update_media.description: Change the alt text or focal point of an uploaded media file.
actions.update_media.props.description.d: New plain-text description of the media for accessibility.
actions.update_media.props.focus.descrip: New focal point as two comma-separated numbers from -1.0 to 1.0, for example 0.0,0.5.
actions.update_media.props.media_id.desc: ID of the unattached media. Obtain it from Upload Media.
actions.update_my_profile.description: Update the display name, bio and settings of the connected account.
actions.update_my_profile.props.bot.desc: Whether the profile is flagged as an automated (bot) account. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
actions.update_my_profile.props.default_: Default ISO 639-1 language code for new posts, for example en.
Default privacy for new posts. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
actions.update_my_profile.props.discover: Whether the account is featured in the profile directory. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
actions.update_my_profile.props.display_: New display name shown on the profile. Leave empty to keep the current display name.
actions.update_my_profile.props.locked.d: Whether new followers must be approved manually. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
actions.update_my_profile.props.note.des: New profile bio text. Leave empty to keep the current bio.
actions.upload_media.description: Upload an image, video or audio file to attach to a status.
actions.upload_media.props.description.d: Describes the media for people using screen readers.
actions.upload_media.props.file.descript: The image, video or audio file to upload.
actions.upload_media.props.focus.descrip: Where thumbnails centre, as x,y from -1.0 to 1.0.
actions.upload_media.props.upload_info.d: Map the returned Media ID into Media IDs on Post, Schedule or Edit Status.
actions.vote_in_poll.description: Cast a vote in a poll.
actions.vote_in_poll.props.choices.descr: 0-based index of each option to vote for, one per item; for example 0 for the first option.
actions.vote_in_poll.props.poll_id.descr: ID of the poll (the poll.id field of a status). Obtain it from Get Status or a timeline.
auth.description:
**Base URL**: the address of your Mastodon server, for example `https://mastodon.social`.

**Access Token**:

1. In Mastodon, open **Preferences** > **Development** > **New Application**.
2. Enter any application name.
3. Under **Scopes**, tick **read** and **write** (only `profile` is ticked by default).
4. Click **Submit**, then open the application.
5. Copy **Your access token** and paste it below.

If a step later fails with a missing-scope error, tick **read** and **write** on the application, save (this creates a new token) and paste the new token here.
auth.props.access_token.description: Created under Preferences > Development; see the steps above.
triggers.new_follower.description: Triggers when someone starts following your account.
triggers.new_follower.props.follower_inf: If your account approves followers by hand, new followers appear once you accept them.
triggers.new_mention.description: Triggers when someone mentions your account, including replies and direct messages.
On Mastodon 4.3 and later, mentions from people you do not follow can be filtered and only trigger once you accept them.
triggers.new_status_from_account.descrip: Triggers when a chosen account publishes a new status.
triggers.new_status_from_account.props.a: A username on your server, or user@domain for another server. An Account ID also works.
For accounts on other servers, only statuses that reach your server are seen; following the account helps.
triggers.new_status_from_account.props.e: Ignore statuses the account boosts from others.
Ignore the account's replies to other people.
triggers.new_status_with_hashtag.descrip: Triggers when a new public status uses a hashtag.
triggers.new_status_with_hashtag.props.h: Without the # sign; a leading # is removed.
Statuses from other servers appear once they reach your server.
triggers.new_status_with_hashtag.props.l: Only statuses from accounts on your server.
triggers.new_status_with_hashtag.props.o: Only statuses with images, video or audio.
